project.name: Example Reference Translation
project.objective: Present the client's studio and lead visitors toward an inquiry.

checkpoints.reason: The synthetic example has no separate brand scan.
checkpoints.notes: Do not infer brand rules from the reference website.
Typography, editorial composition and media sequence were reviewed.
The single-page narrative and primary inquiry path were approved.

navigation.desktop: Centered route group with inquiry action.
navigation.mobile: Compact trigger with equivalent keyboard and touch access.

global_system.responsive_strategy: Preserve hierarchy and focal media while reflowing editorial masses instead of merely stacking columns.
global_system.motion_strategy: Use motion only where evidence supports sequence, direct manipulation or continuity.
global_system.accessibility_strategy: Preserve focus, keyboard access, touch equivalents and meaningful reduced-motion states.

home.purpose: Establish the studio proposition and lead to the primary inquiry journey.

content_policy.notes: Line breaks may adapt, but the proposition and CTA meaning cannot change.

reference_patterns.rationale: The target hero needs the same editorial dominance without reusing the reference content.
The supplied hero image becomes the first state of a sequence-ready media region.

composition.dominant_mass: Large proposition occupying the lower-left visual field.
composition.secondary_mass: Supporting copy and action aligned to the opposite edge.
composition.intended_empty_space: Upper center remains quiet so the headline and media do not compete.
composition.figure_ground: High-contrast type remains distinct from the active media field.
composition.media_focal_strategy: Preserve the subject focal point and allow recrop rather than distortion.

desktop.layout_intent: Asymmetric editorial split with simultaneous media and copy.
desktop.media_behavior: Wide crop preserving the declared focal point.

tablet.layout_intent: Reduced split retaining visual tension and readable copy measure.
tablet.media_behavior: Recrop around the focal point without changing aspect arbitrarily.

mobile.layout_intent: Sequential composition with headline dominance and touch-safe action.
mobile.media_behavior: Taller crop centered on the declared focal point.

behaviors.implementation_intent: Maintain ordered media continuity without replacing it with a generic fade.
behaviors.desktop: Sequence advances with the observed continuity and pacing hierarchy.
behaviors.mobile: Sequence remains legible at a reduced amplitude and touch-safe pace.
behaviors.reduced_motion: Show one stable representative frame with no automatic displacement.

visual: Headline is the dominant painted mass.
content: All supplied hero copy and the primary CTA remain represented.
responsive: Mobile preserves hierarchy instead of simply shrinking desktop.
behavior: Reduced motion has a stable equivalent.

uncertainties: Exact transition timing remains adaptive until the reference lab is measured.

runtime_content.source: Titular y fotografia de la campana vigente, editables desde el CMS
tolerates: Titular de hasta tres lineas a 1440; la cuarta desborda el area del hero
Sin fotografia cargada: cae al campo de color plano de la marca
Fotografia vertical: se recorta al centro y puede perder los bordes
Titular vacio: la seccion mantiene su alto y muestra solo el antetitulo
runtime_content.notes: El resto de la composicion se congela en el build: la posicion del bloque de texto y el comportamiento al hacer scroll no dependen del CMS.

decisions.rationale: The example has editorial content and lightweight interactions with no server-state requirement.

approval.notes: Synthetic approved fixture for validator and documentation use.
